title.en: An Act to Convert the Sitios of Malaguining and Cancorvenus, Both in the Municipality of Talalora, Province of Samar, to a Barrio to be Known as Barrio San Francisco of the Same Municipality

text.en: The sitios of Malaguining and Cancorvenus, both in the Municipality of Talalora, Province of Samar, are hereby converted to a barrio to be known as Barrio San Francisco of the same municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 7, 1959.
